# ezily-io.github.io

Staging mirror of the Ezily marketing site, served at https://ezily-io.github.io

**Generated output. Do not edit anything here by hand.** Every file except this
README and `.nojekyll` is built from `content/` in the private `ezily-website`
repository by its `build.py`, and any edit made here is overwritten by the next
publish. Change the copy there, not here.

`robots.txt` disallows all crawling: the live site is https://ezily.io and this
mirror must not compete with it in search results.
